rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for meaning “very” or “extremely,” as in “highly visible.”

example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 hei3 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4

rows.note: Use this when “highly” describes strongly praising, supporting, or recommending someone or something in everyday speech.

example.jyutping: ngo5 daai6 lik6 teoi1 zin3 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1

rows.note: Use this formal choice in collocations such as “高度評價” when expressing high regard rather than mere intensity.

example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 wok6 gou1 dou6 ping4 gaa3
